## Context / Problem
The code-review `tests` overlay (blocking at 0.54 — `src/rebar/llm/code_review/criteria_routing.json:110-119`)
is selected only when a changed file matches `**/test_*.py`, `**/*_test.py`, `**/tests/**`
(`src/rebar/llm/code_review/registry.py:295-311`, `glob_triggered_overlays`). A change that adds
product logic and touches no test file never runs the overlay unless the base reviewer recommends
it, and the overlay's guard (vii) (`src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-tests.md:97`) keeps a bare
coverage-gap finding advisory. Four changes that added definitions under `src/` merged on
`LLM-Review +1` with zero test files — Gerrit 388 (`d9e0f0e733`, 15 added `def`/`class` lines, new
`git_adapter.py`), 1920 (`721cb7d6ac`, 3), 1737 (`1c2bf6e57b`, 22), 1703 (`83d91d488c`, 8) — and
change 388 later produced three bugs (`79c6-eaf3-38af-4ce9`, `b0a8-5496-d178-40a9`,
`cfe1-3572-4536-49d3`, the `git_adapter` by-path-load family the parent epic names). Gerrit 1547
(`24917e843b`) was also cited in the fortnight review but is NOT in this population: its src delta
is comment-only (0 added `def`/`class` lines, 0 added branch lines) and it also changed four docs
files, so it is used here as a NEGATIVE case. Approved in the fortnight defect review (operator
decision, 2026-08-21); the diff-coverage alternative was rejected because the project tests
behaviour and contracts, not coverage percentage.

## Approach
Fire the `tests` overlay from the diff CONTENT, in the one place that knows both the diff and the
changed files.

1. `registry.content_triggered_overlays` (`src/rebar/llm/code_review/registry.py:416`) currently
   takes `(diff_text, repo_root)` only — it is path-blind by construction (every helper skips the
   `+++`/`---` headers). Extend it with a keyword-only `changed_files: Sequence[str] = ()`, so the
   two existing call sites and every existing test keep working positionally, and pass the step's
   `changed` list at `src/rebar/llm/code_review/workflow_ops.py:99`.
2. The detector is a NEW module-level helper (`_has_added_definition`), not extra branches inside
   `content_triggered_overlays`: `scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` fails on `new>0`
   and the baseline may not be raised. It fires when an ADDED (`+`) line under a `src/**` file
   header starts a function/method/class definition or a new conditional branch, AND no changed
   file matches the `tests` overlay's own globs. Definition-line provenance is tracked per
   `diff --git`/`+++ b/` header, since the composed context interleaves files.
3. Two suppressions, both required by the cited corpus: an added definition line whose text differs
   from a removed definition line in the same hunk only by type annotations, whitespace or
   decorators does NOT count (that is Gerrit 1703's shape); comment-only and blank-line additions
   never count (Gerrit 1547's shape). A file MOVE is not suppressed: the gate's diff is produced by
   `git diff base...head` with no `-M` (`src/rebar/llm/code_review/assemble.py:230`), so a rename
   arrives as delete + add and the moved definitions are indistinguishable from new ones — 1920 and
   1737 therefore trigger, by design.
4. The detector runs against the COMPOSED context, not a raw diff: `overlay_union` receives
   `steps.assemble_diff.outputs.context` (`src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/code-review.yaml:64`,
   `:118`), which is a `## Changed files` list plus the diff truncated at `DIFF_CHAR_CAP = 60000`
   (`assemble.py:30`, `compose_diff_context` :78-93). Tests must exercise BOTH shapes, and the
   truncation limitation is recorded: an added definition past the cap does not trigger. The
   `changed_files` operand is unaffected by truncation, which is why the negative half of the rule
   is keyed on it rather than on the diff text.
5. Narrow guard (vii) in `code-review-tests.md:97` so a gap on *newly introduced* behaviour with a
   named violating input is blocking-eligible, while a gap on pre-existing code stays advisory.
   This is ONE prompt shared by Round-A and Round-B, so the narrowing applies to the existing
   glob-triggered population too — that is intended, and the eval corpus gains the matching
   pre-existing-code FP case so the 0.54 calibration is exercised on both halves.
6. `criteria_routing.json` gains trigger provenance in the `tests` entry's `_comment` only; the
   committed `applies_to` globs are unchanged. No project overlay change is possible or needed:
   `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` has no `tests` entry, and its extension mechanism
   (`registry.project_trigger_extensions`, `registry.py:254`) offers only literal-substring
   `trigger_tokens` and additive `applies_to` globs — neither can express "adds a definition AND
   touches no `tests/**`".

## Scope
- `src/rebar/llm/code_review/registry.py` — `changed_files` kwarg + `_has_added_definition` helper.
- `src/rebar/llm/code_review/workflow_ops.py` — pass `changed` at the `content_triggered_overlays`
  call (`:99`) and refresh the registered step's `description=` (`:70-86`), which currently names
  deletion-impact as the only content example.
- `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-tests.md` — guard (vii) at `:97`.
- `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/code-review-tests.eval.yaml` — one recall case (gap on newly added
  behaviour) + one FP case (gap on pre-existing code), keeping `test_code_review_dataset_balanced`
  green.
- `src/rebar/llm/code_review/criteria_routing.json` — `tests` `_comment` provenance only.
- `tests/unit/test_code_review_tests_trigger.py` (new; flat `tests/unit/` layout — there is no
  `tests/unit/llm/` package).

Deliberately unchanged, recorded as accepted consequences: the Pass-4 coach moves keyed on the
`tests` tag (`moves.py:26-31`, `:74-84`) now offer on ordinary src changes; Round-A is uncapped
(`cap: 3` exists only on the Round-B `union` step, `code-review.yaml:118`), so each qualifying
change costs one extra frontier overlay call.

## Testing
Happy path: a diff adding `def` under `src/` with no `tests/` change selects `tests`, asserted both
on a raw diff and on the same diff run through `assemble.compose_diff_context` (the production
shape). Replay: the four cited merged changes' diff shapes select it; Gerrit 1547's comment-only src
shape and 1703's annotation-only signature-rewrite shape do not. Edge: docs-only, config-only, and
comment-only diffs do not select it; a diff adding a `def` plus a test file still selects it by glob
(union, not replacement). Pinning: `tests/unit/test_code_review_triggers.py`,
`tests/unit/test_code_review_deletion_impact.py`, `tests/unit/test_code_review_evals.py` (58 tests,
green at baseline) pass unchanged — their fixtures use non-`src/` paths or removed definitions, so
no `== ["deletion-impact"]` / `== []` equality assertion flips. `scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py`
and `tests/unit/test_criteria_vocabulary_reviewers.py` cover the reviewer-prompt edit;
`tests/unit/test_prompt_index.py` is NOT a gate on this file (`category: code-review-pass` prompts
are excluded from `reviewers/index.json`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A diff whose only `src/**` addition is a function/method/class definition, with no changed
      file under `tests/**`, selects `tests` from `registry.content_triggered_overlays`, and the
      same diff run through `overlay_union` sets `include_tests` true; asserted on BOTH a raw diff
      and the `compose_diff_context` output for the same diff. Checked by
      `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_code_review_tests_trigger.py -q`.
- [ ] The four cited merged shapes select it and the two non-behaviour shapes do not, as a
      parametrised replay over synthetic diffs reproducing each change's shape: SELECT for
      `d9e0f0e733` (new module, 15 added definitions), `721cb7d6ac` (moved definitions, 3),
      `1c2bf6e57b` (module split, 22); DO NOT SELECT for `24917e843b` (comment-only `src/` delta —
      `git show 24917e843b -- 'src/*' | grep -cE '^\+\s*(async +)?(def|class) '` returns `0`) and
      `83d91d488c` (annotation-only signature rewrite). Checked by the same test.
- [ ] Docs-only, config-only, and test-file-only diffs do not content-select it, and a diff adding a
      `def` under `src/` *plus* a `tests/` file still selects it via `glob_triggered_overlays`
      (union, not replacement). Checked by the same test.
- [ ] The existing trigger pinning is byte-identical: `python -m pytest
      tests/unit/test_code_review_triggers.py tests/unit/test_code_review_deletion_impact.py -q`
      passes with no test edited (46 tests, green before and after).
- [ ] Guard (vii) at `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-tests.md` distinguishes newly-introduced
      from pre-existing behaviour, and the Four-Criterion Test bullet is unchanged; asserted by a
      test that loads the packaged prompt via `prompts.get_prompt("code-review-tests")` and checks
      both. Checked by `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_code_review_tests_trigger.py -q`.
- [ ] The reviewer-prompt and eval-corpus gates pass with the new cases:
      `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_code_review_evals.py tests/unit/test_criteria_vocabulary_reviewers.py -q`
      and `python scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py`.
- [ ] The repo gates hold with no baseline edit: `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check`
      reports `new=0 increased=0`, and `src/rebar/llm/code_review/registry.py` stays under the
      800-line cap in `.github/module-size-limit.txt`.

## Review remediation (2026-08-21)
- `registry.content_triggered_overlays` (`registry.py:416`) takes only `(diff_text, repo_root)`, so the "changes no file under `tests/**`" half of the rule could not be computed where the plan put it; a `changed_files` kwarg plus the `workflow_ops.py:99` call site is now in Approach and Scope.
- The `diff_text` the step scans is `assemble_diff.outputs.context` (`code-review.yaml:64`, `:118`) — the composed `## Changed files` + orientation + diff shape truncated at `DIFF_CHAR_CAP = 60000` (`assemble.py:30`, `:78-93`) — so an added definition past the cap does not trigger; the blind spot is recorded and both shapes are now tested.
- Gerrit 1547 (`24917e843b`) has 0 added `def`/`class` lines and 0 added branch lines in `src/` and also changed four docs files, so the old "five src-only changes" AC was unsatisfiable; it is now an explicit NEGATIVE case.
- Gerrit 1920 and 1737 are pure MOVES and 1703 is an annotation-only signature rewrite, contradicting the old claim that "pure renames add no definitions and never trigger"; moves now trigger by design and annotation-only rewrites are suppressed explicitly.
- Rename detection is OFF in the reviewed diff (`git diff base...head` with no `-M`, `assemble.py:230`), so a rename reaches the reviewer as delete + add; the old `git diff -M` rename-only edge case tested a shape production never sends.
- Two code citations were wrong: `content_triggered_overlays` is at `registry.py:416` (not `:413`), and guard (vii) is at `code-review-tests.md:97` (`:73-75` is the Four-Criterion Test bullet the plan leaves unchanged).
- `tests/unit/llm/` does not exist, so both the new test path and the `tests/unit/llm/code_review/test_registry*.py` pinning path were unreachable; the flat `tests/unit/test_code_review_*.py` layout and the real pinning suites are named instead.
- Narrowing guard (vii) edits ONE prompt shared by Round-A and Round-B, so it changes blocking eligibility for the whole existing glob-triggered population (calibrated at 0.54, "blocks 99 changes / 8.0%"), not only the new content-triggered one; that is now stated as intended.
- `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/code-review-tests.eval.yaml` (the calibration corpus the routing `_comment` names, already carrying `R-missing-regression-test`) and the `tests`-keyed Pass-4 coach moves (`moves.py:26-31`, `:74-84`) were unlisted consumers; the eval spec is now in Scope and the coach-move fan-out is recorded as an accepted consequence.
